tasks.short: Develop sustainability recommendations from assessed options

steps.what: Read existing environmental and economic studies; verify and capture option identifiers, costs, benefits, uncertainty and source references
inputs: Existing studies produced by research staff
outputs: Checked option evidence and explicit table mapping

steps.what: Transfer exact checked scenario results into the option comparison table
inputs: Checked results and mapping from s1
outputs: Comparison table with original units and references; missing fields flagged

steps.what: Develop sustainability and sustainable development policy recommendations; assess distributional effects, feasibility and uncertainty and record the actual recommendation and limitations
outputs: Human economic and policy reasoning with selected recommendation

steps.what: Write and check the recommendation brief, using native links to exact option values and source references
outputs: Completed recommendation brief

steps.what: Save the completed brief in its existing document workspace
outputs: Saved brief

tasks.design: Use {SPREADSHEET} to transfer exact assessed results into an option table, then link those values into {DOCS}. The economist develops the recommendation and checks the completed brief; adoption is a separate institutional decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scenario results and source references are copied between research tables and recommendation drafts.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit field mappings and native document links can preserve values without generating policy reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Trade-offs, distributional effects and uncertain environmental outcomes require economic judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Accountability for the actual recommendation and its limits.

ambition.what: Compare an additional credible policy option when the evidence already exists.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to confirm actual study access and workflow

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact table transfers and document field links can reduce repeated copying while retaining human policy assessment.

assumptions: Representative recommendation-development episode with existing studies and an actual comparison brief, not an assertion about every policy project. Research staff produce the original studies during their existing work; their effort is unchanged, while economist verification and capture are fully counted in s1. New research or consultation is additional real work if required.
s1 produces every identifier, source reference, unit and mapping consumed by s2. Missing or incompatible data return to manual investigation; no clean scenario feed is assumed.
Check native spreadsheet links first. Existing transfers already automated yield no additional saving. s4 reduces only literal value and reference copying; economic writing and all checking remain.

Development here ends with an internal brief. Enactment, public consultation, publication or sending it requires its actual authority and distinct action steps before estimating that broader workflow. No author self-approval is introduced.

Shares are provisional work estimates independent of the prompt prior. The integer schema minimum of 1 for s5 represents negligible same-system saving effort, fully retained with no saving. Gross saving is 20+19*0.30=25.7 per 100; incremental upkeep 4 gives net 21.7. Retained source, reasoning and brief work total 73.3 and are already counted.
unknowns: Whether current option tables are already linked
Whether this project needs original research or consultation
research_questions: Observe one actual recommendation brief: which fields are retyped, and which are already linked?

already_counted.description: Source capture, policy reasoning and checking the completed recommendation remain in s1, s3 and s4.

incremental.description: Maintain option mappings and check source-link failures beyond ordinary study and brief checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires the observed result-transfer workload and 30% less literal copying in the brief. If native tables already perform s2, gross falls to 5.7; 3.7 points of mapping and link upkeep leave 2. No gain is inferred for human policy choices.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop environmental and economic data systems

steps.what: Inspect actual collection forms and source samples; capture schemas, units, permissions, missing-data rules and validation examples
inputs: Actual samples and collection practices supplied by source owners
outputs: Explicit source and collection contracts with test examples

steps.what: Develop systems for collecting, analyzing and interpreting environmental and economic data; specify collection controls, analysis methods and interpretation limits
inputs: Actual research questions and methodological constraints
outputs: Human system specification and test expectations

steps.what: Implement a prototype collection and analysis pipeline from the specification; review generated code and correct failures
inputs: Explicit source contracts and human specification
outputs: Reviewed prototype code with execution results

loop.purpose: Draft implementation code for a human-defined pipeline
loop.input: Explicit schema, methods and test examples
loop.check: Economist reads the code, verifies units and method implementation, and reruns expected cases
loop.stop: Two failed revisions, unknown input semantics or any unresolved method mismatch returns implementation to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native import, validation and analysis configuration first; use code drafting only for the remaining project-specific transformations

steps.what: Test collection edge cases and analytical reproducibility against original examples; write actual findings and limitations
outputs: Tested prototype and actual development findings

steps.what: Save prototype and findings in the existing development workspace
outputs: Saved development artefacts

tasks.design: Develop the collection and analysis prototype in {DATA_PLATFORM} from a specification captured in {DOCS}. Native configuration comes first; a bounded code-drafting loop assists only remaining implementation work, followed by human reproducibility and collection tests.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project-specific collection rules and transformations require manual implementation and debugging.
tasks.enabler_now: Code drafting can work against explicit schemas and executable examples rather than guessing environmental data semantics.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling, measurement error, missingness, analytical validity and interpretation remain methodological choices.
tasks.human_edge: Translate real environmental measurement practices into defensible analytical contracts.

ambition.what: Offer a tested prototype for a new environmental data collection study.

reach.task: Review production deployment requirements after prototype development
reach.learn: Which source contracts and access restrictions the prototype actually requires

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to inspect actual source permissions and development environment

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: code drafting against explicit schemas and test cases can assist prototype implementation, while methodological choices and validation require human work.

assumptions: This is development work by an economist who actually implements a prototype, not the subsequent operation of a system. No runtime import or analysis saving is claimed as a saving in system development.

Source owners provide actual samples from their existing collection work; the economist's inspection, schema capture and test-expectation production are fully counted in s1 and s2. New measurement, cleaning or permission work cannot be supplied for free.

s3 uses only permitted non-sensitive examples. Native collection and validation controls are evaluated first; if they already remove implementation effort there is no new code-drafting benefit for that part.

All code review, test checking, corrections and stopping failures are included in s3; independent methodological and reproducibility checking is retained in s4. Findings are the actual development record, not an invented report after a conversation.

Production deployment, live collection activation and release are outside this prototype-development episode and must be separate authorised actions if actually required. Saving development artefacts is ungated and carries no saving; no self-approval is added.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross is 35*0.50=17.5; new focal upkeep 4 leaves net 13.5. Retained development labour in s1-s4 is 81.5, already counted. Minimum integer save share 1 is fully retained and represents negligible effort.
unknowns: Whether this economist writes code or delegates implementation
How much custom transformation remains after native configuration
research_questions: Inspect one recent system-development project and measure implementation work and failed revisions separately from operation.

already_counted.description: Source contracts, system specification, implementation review and development testing are retained in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain code-drafting tests and investigate tool-specific failures beyond existing prototype development checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The upper bound requires halving custom implementation effort while retaining all specified checking. In a prototype dominated by difficult source semantics, implementation retains 80%: gross 7 minus 4 upkeep leaves 3. Measure native configuration and delegated engineering before using either estimate.

steps.what: Read the actual funding call and source records; capture eligibility, questions, institution facts, budget inputs and exact references
outputs: Verified call requirements and application field mapping

steps.what: Develop and record the actual research question, methods, work plan, resource estimates and environmental-economic contribution
inputs: Actual research ideas and available resources
outputs: Human research proposal content and budget rationale

steps.what: Fill exact institutional details, work-plan fields and budget values into the application draft
inputs: Verified field mapping and human proposal content
outputs: Application draft with exact populated fields and blanks flagged

steps.what: Draft narrative sections from the actual research plan; check every claim and revise the text
inputs: Human research plan and verified sources
outputs: Human-checked application narrative

loop.purpose: Express the economist's actual research plan within the call structure
loop.input: Verified sources, human plan and exact call questions
loop.output: Draft narrative with source references and missing claims marked
loop.check: Economist checks each claim, methodological statement, reference and resource commitment
loop.stop: Unsupported claims are deleted; two failed drafts return writing to the economist
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native templates and field fill for fixed content; only project-specific narrative needs semantic drafting

steps.what: Read the entire application against the call, research plan and original budget; resolve inconsistencies
outputs: Completed application draft

steps.what: Save the completed application in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved application draft

tasks.design: Populate exact application fields in {DOCS} from verified records and budget inputs in {SPREADSHEET}. A bounded drafting loop expresses the economist's actual study design, followed by full application checking; this writing task ends with a saved draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated institutional fields and call-specific narrative consume writing time.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic field fill handles exact facts, while source-bounded drafting can assist project-specific prose.
tasks.still_hard: A credible research question, methods and deliverable resource commitments require original work.
tasks.human_edge: Design a fundable study and stand behind its actual methods and costs.

ambition.what: Adapt a completed study concept to another genuinely suitable funding call.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to confirm institutional record and drafting access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact field fill and source-bounded narrative drafting can assist application preparation without inventing research methods or institutional commitments.

assumptions: A representative application-writing episode, with actual institutional records produced by institutional owners and existing research records by researchers. Economist verification and capture are fully in s1; original study and resource design are fully in s2. New partner consultation is real additional work if required.

s1 and s2 produce all fields used in s3 and all substantive content used in s4. Missing evidence remains blank and returns to manual investigation; no invented collaborators, permissions, results, references or budget facts.

Use native templates and existing mail-merge or field fill first. Existing automated fields carry no new benefit. s4 retains drafting review and revisions; s5 retains full independent comparison against originals.

Writing an application is distinct from obtaining institutional permission or submitting it. If actual submission is included, the completed final version needs its real institutional authority followed by a distinct send action; none is silently included here. Ordinary save has no author self-approval and no saving.

These provisional shares ignore prompt time shares. Gross 10+25*0.40=20; incremental upkeep 3 yields net 17. Retained s1,s2,s4,s5 labour is 79 already counted. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible same-system effort and is fully retained.
unknowns: Whether current application templates already populate fixed fields
Actual institutional submission and permission process
research_questions: Compare one real application draft with its call and identify fixed fields, original design work and narrative revision time.

already_counted.description: Source capture, original study design, narrative review and complete application checking remain in s1,s2,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain application mappings and source-bounded drafting checks beyond current application preparation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound combines removal of exact field copying with 40% less narrative writing effort after review. For a call whose fixed fields are already populated, narrative retains 72%, giving gross 7 minus 3 upkeep, or 4. Original research design remains fully retained.

tasks.short: Examine resource exhaustion and rehabilitation costs

steps.what: Find, read and verify resource stock, extraction and rehabilitation studies; capture actual values, units, dates and source references
inputs: Existing resource and rehabilitation studies produced by researchers
outputs: Checked evidence and explicit model input values

steps.what: Choose and record the actual depletion or rehabilitation model, scenarios, discount assumptions, time basis and missing-data treatment
outputs: Explicit human model specification, formulas and captured inputs

steps.what: Apply the explicitly specified period, depletion, cost and discount formulas to captured inputs; generate scenario comparison tables
inputs: Exact inputs, units and human formulas from s2
outputs: Reproducible scenario values with missing inputs flagged

steps.what: Check calculations against original evidence and assess uncertainty, resource limits and rehabilitation implications
outputs: Human economic interpretation with limitations

steps.what: Write the actual working research finding and its source and model references
outputs: Checked working research entry

steps.what: Save the working research entry in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved research entry

tasks.design: Use native source filters in {DOCS} and explicit scenario formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The economist captures inputs, chooses assumptions, checks results and records the actual research finding; the calculation does not infer resource exhaustion or future rehabilitation obligations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and manually repeated scenario calculations slow sensitivity analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters and explicit spreadsheet formulas can repeat literal calculations consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain stocks, substitution, future costs and discount assumptions can dominate conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret conditional results without presenting assumptions as observed environmental facts.

ambition.what: Test an additional defensible cost or depletion assumption with unchanged human interpretation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to confirm source and analytical workbook access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source filters and explicit spreadsheet formulas can assist repeated environmental-economic scenario calculations without establishing their assumptions or validity.

assumptions: Representative desk-analysis episode using actual existing studies and an actual working research entry. Original studies are produced by researchers during their existing work; original collection effort remains unchanged. Source verification, unit checking and input capture are counted in s1 and s2.

s1's reduction is only repeated navigation through existing indexed studies. Full reading and verification remain. No automatic extraction, ready-made clean feed or inferred resource value is assumed.

s2 produces every formula, period convention, scenario and input used by s3. Missing values stop that scenario and return to manual investigation. Existing formula execution has no new gain; only observed manual repetition is eligible.

s4 checks original inputs and arithmetic as well as interpreting results. s5 is a real working finding for this research episode, not an invented report after every discussion. No publication, financial recommendation send or policy adoption is included; if required each needs real additional work and authority.

Provisional shares ignore the prompt prior. Gross 20*0.20+25=29; new upkeep 4 leaves net 25. Retained s1,s2,s4,s5 labour is 70, already counted. Save share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible same-system effort, fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which scenarios are already calculated automatically
Actual measurement uncertainty and source comparability
research_questions: Observe a resource or rehabilitation analysis and separate source reading, assumption choice, manual recalculation and interpretation.

already_counted.description: Source verification, model specification, result checking, interpretation and actual finding writing remain in s1,s2,s4,s5.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario formulas and source filters beyond existing analytical checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound assumes observed manual repetition across scenario calculations plus reduced source navigation. If existing formulas already handle 17 of the 25 calculation points, eligible gross is 4+8=12; 4 upkeep leaves 8. When calculations are already fully native, re-estimate below this range.
